body:
Closes the receipt's own pending limit: 'TS port to edge/worker.ts + automated parity runner still pending'.

## What
- `edge/nl_route_core.mjs` — framework-free ESM port of the canonical router (measured 50/50 on the pre-registered eval set)
- `edge/synonym_graph.mjs` — generated graph module with embedded sha256; drift-detectable at import
- `edge/worker.ts` — STYLE_RULES keyword table (0.560 baseline) removed; routes via `makeRouter()`, response shape unchanged
- `tools/nl_parity.mjs` — 7 pins, FAIL-first: 6/7 red pre-port → 7/7 green post-port (receipt `tools/nl_parity_receipt.json`)

## Verified
- Parity: core ≡ reference on all 50 eval prompts + 10 adversarial probes (class, score, hits identical)
- E2E: actual worker.ts executed under node type-stripping — woodcut / negation-suppression / but-pivot / zero-hit default / empty prompt / GET 405 / OPTIONS 200 all correct
- `score_eval.py` docstring marked as frozen baseline instrument (not re-run, doc-only)

Stacked on edge-nl-graph (PR #2). Main untouched. Casey-gated.
title: Edge worker graph-port: worker.ts routes via synonym-graph router, parity-pinned
